[ It's a sealed-bid second-price auction (Vickrey). With independent private values and risk-neutral preferences, the dominant strategy is to bid truthfully, regardless of others’ strategies or the number of bidders. There’s no exploitable history and only one round, so no scope for dynamic adjustments. Overbidding risks paying more than my value if I win; underbidding risks losing when winning would be profitable. Therefore, to maximize expected profit this round, I bid exactly my value. ]
